plugins.description: YnotOne reporting in Claude: the read-only reporting connector, a skill that knows which report answers which question and what its numbers mean, and commands for a question, a call-cadence review and a weekly summary.

skills.name: ynot-reporting
skills.description: Answers questions about an admissions team's YnotOne (Ynot LMS) data — leads, lead sources and channels, campuses, reps, calls and call outcomes, speed to lead, call cadence adherence, appointments, conversions, enrollments and starts, email and SMS, campaign spend and pacing — using the YnotOne reporting connector. Use whenever a question needs those numbers, names a Ynot report, or asks to compare campuses, reps, sources or periods.
skills.description_zh: 通过YnotOne报告连接器回答招生团队的线索、来源渠道、校区、人员、电话结果、响应速度、呼叫节奏、预约、转化、入学、邮件短信和活动支出进度问题，并比较校区、人员、来源或期间。
